prompt_text: Who is the best mortgage lender in St. Charles MO for a home purchase loan?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one universally “best” lender—the right choice depends on your credit, down payment, loan type, and how quickly you need to close. **For a local starting point, I’d compare First State Bank of St. Charles and Guild Mortgage.** Both have a local presence and strong reported customer ratings; Guild’s St. Charles office lists a 4.95 rating on Experience.com, and First State Bank is listed at 4.94. Ratings are only one signal, though, and don’t tell you which lender will offer the best deal for your situation.

Also consider **First Community Credit Union** if you’re eligible for membership and want to explore first-time-buyer or low-down-payment options. Its published programs include a no-PMI option with a 10% down payment, subject to qualifications.

Get written Loan Estimates from at least three lenders for the same loan amount, down payment, and loan type. Compare the **APR, lender fees, points, rate-lock period, and estimated cash to close**—not just the advertised rate. Ask each lender about closing timelines and any assistance programs you may qualify for.
